title: BOC vows crackdown on smuggling after Zambales cigarette haul

blocks.text: IBA, Zambales — The Bureau of Customs (BOC) vowed to intensify its campaign against smuggling after seizing four shipping containers loaded with untaxed cigarettes worth an estimated P175 million at BNB Pier in Sitio Luan, Barangay Lipay, Palauig, Zambales. “We will not allow shipments that evade taxes to slip through. With the help of our partner agencies, we will continue to strengthen our monitoring to protect public funds and the livelihoods of businesses that comply with the law,” Customs Commissioner Ariel Nepomuceno said in a statement on Saturday, Oct. 24.
